blocks.orig: The Mbali Mbali Gombe Lodge in Gombe Stream National Park features 7 luxury safari tents with corrugated roofs, situated in the shadow of ancient mangotrees, offering a view over Lake Tanganyika. Each tent boasts an en-suite bathroom, large beds, and a balcony in paradise, complete with a small table and safari chairs. Here, you can relax and enjoy the breathtaking sunsets over the lake after your amazing chimp trekking. The canvas tents are set wide apart to ensure complete privacy on the strip of forest between the coast and the mountain. A small reception room built on stilts on the beach has a bar, lounge, library, and dining room. A jetty leads you over the lake, and comfortable deck chairs are available on the beach.
blocks.html: In Gombe Stream National Park, The Mbali Mbali Gombe Lodge has 7 luxury safari tents with corrugated roofs, set in the shade of ancient mango trees and looking out over Lake Tanganyika. Every tent has an en-suite bathroom, large beds and a heavenly balcony with a small table and safari chairs. After your wonderful chimp trekking, this is where you unwind and watch the breathtaking sunsets over the lake. To guarantee full privacy, the canvas tents are spaced widely along the strip of forest between the shore and the mountain. On the beach, a small reception building on stilts holds a bar, lounge, library and dining room. A jetty takes you out over the lake, and on the beach you will find comfortable deck chairs.
